北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，今天雾气大，体感 -7℃，注意保暖和交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's foggy and feels like -7℃. Stay warm and safe!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 6℃，风和日丽，心情也会很好吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with a pleasant 6℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海今天有雾，体感 7℃，出行要小心，注意防潮哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai, it's foggy and feels like 7℃. Drive safely and mind the dampness.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴天，体感 11℃ 很舒服，湿度高，衣服别穿太多啦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and a comfortable 11℃. High humidity, dress lightly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，体感 14℃，正是出游的好时机，记得防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and 14℃. Perfect for outdoor activities, don't forget sunscreen!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴好，体感 4℃，微风轻拂，出门加件外套别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear and feels like 4℃. A light jacket will keep you cozy.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天气晴朗，体感 4℃，阳光暖暖的，注意适度增减衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 4℃. Enjoy the warmth, dress accordingly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃，湿度 98%，记得防潮保暖，小心感冒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 3℃ with high humidity. Stay warm and dry!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 5℃，湿度较高，出门带伞，注意添衣哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 5℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella and layer up.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 1℃，天气干燥，多喝水，注意皮肤保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 1℃. It's dry, so stay hydrated and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾蒙蒙，体感 9℃，能见度低，开车的朋友要慢行。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 9℃. Low visibility, drive carefully!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨今天晴朗但体感 -22℃，风力大，出门务必穿厚点！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -22℃ with strong winds. Bundle up warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 -4℃，气温不高，记得防寒保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels like -4℃. Stay warm and cozy!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 8℃，气温适中，享受春城好天气。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 8℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 12℃，阳光正好，适合海边散步，注意防晒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 12℃. Perfect for a beach stroll, remember sunscreen!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴天，体感 5℃，有微风，出门别忘了加件防风外套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear and feels like 5℃ with a breeze. Bring a windbreaker!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 1℃，天气较冷，出门注意多穿些衣服哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like 1℃. It's quite cold, dress warmly!
